changelog: Initial release: Manage Coda Pack shells via REST API v1. Supports listing, creating, updating, and deleting private Packs. Note: Builds, Gallery submission, Analytics require Pack SDK CLI (npx @codahq/packs-sdk).
summary: Manage private Coda Packs by listing, creating, updating metadata, and deleting Packs using the Coda REST API v1 and CODA_API_TOKEN.
